research_question: How broad are common variation and lower-tail co-exceedance within the fixed S2 crypto core?
interval: 2,000-replication moving-block bootstrap intervals with block-length sensitivity
sample: S2 fixed stable core, 2021-01-02 through 2026-06-30, n=2006 matched returns
title: Common variation is broad, and BTC lower-tail co-exceedance is above its independence benchmark for the shown pairs.
subtitle: variance share and excess joint probability
interpretation: Common variation is broad, and BTC lower-tail co-exceedance is above its independence benchmark for the shown pairs.
limitation: Fixed PIT-eligible membership supports within-sample dependence statements, not forecasts, causal transmission, or investability claims.

research_question: How do conditional crypto-equity exposures vary over time and across a predeclared era split?
interval: HAC confidence intervals and multiplicity-adjusted formal interaction tests
sample: XNYS-aligned BTC/ETH and TradFi observations, 2020-01-03 through 2026-04-14, n=1577
title: Conditional QQQ exposure varies over time, while formal ETF-era interaction estimates are weak.
subtitle: conditional QQQ beta
interpretation: Conditional QQQ exposure varies over time, while formal ETF-era interaction estimates are weak.
limitation: Contemporaneous period comparisons do not identify ETF effects or causal transmission.

research_question: How do ETF flow-intensity lag associations and regulated-futures positioning line up with market outcomes?
interval: 2,000-replication moving-block simultaneous max-t intervals for ETF lags
sample: Actual BTC/ETH ETF report dates through 2026-04-10 and CFTC standard contracts through 2026-06-30
title: ETF lag evidence is mostly weak under simultaneous bands; CFTC positioning provides separate weekly context.
subtitle: return coefficient per flow-intensity basis point and net share of open interest
interpretation: ETF lag evidence is mostly weak under simultaneous bands; CFTC positioning provides separate weekly context.
limitation: Reporting-time uncertainty and simultaneity prevent a price-impact interpretation.

research_question: How do lagged leverage states coincide with conditional tail stress and cross-asset connectedness?
interval: Bootstrap intervals for state associations; FEVD stability and row-sum diagnostics
sample: BTC state model, 2020-02-01 through 2026-04-12; S2 connectedness from 2021
title: Tail probabilities vary nonlinearly over observed leverage support, while stable-core connectedness changes through time.
subtitle: conditional probability and connectedness percent
interpretation: Tail probabilities vary nonlinearly over observed leverage support, while stable-core connectedness changes through time.
limitation: These are stress-state associations, not forecasts, trading signals, or liquidation-cause estimates.

research_question: How did point-in-time effective breadth and top-100 membership turnover change?
interval: Descriptive monthly census; exact decomposition residual is reported as a diagnostic
sample: Complete monthly PIT top-100 snapshots, January 2020 through May 2026
title: Effective market breadth and constituent turnover changed materially across complete monthly snapshots.
subtitle: entropy-implied asset count and monthly turnover rate
interpretation: Effective market breadth and constituent turnover changed materially across complete monthly snapshots.
limitation: Monthly PIT evidence supports market-structure statements only, not daily historical constituent performance.

interval: Deterministic coverage audit; no sampling interval applies
title: Coverage differs across source blocks because their valid starts and native calendars differ.

research_question: What remains after price-adjusting USD TVL growth, and how mechanical is same-day MVRV?
